name: Gmina Czarny Dunajec (Poland)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, the red charged with a white crowned eagle above crossed axes, the charge from the gmina arms.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: crowned eagle and crossed axes from the gmina arms
